about: Static HTML pages: .html (and .htm) files, edited as source and previewed in a sandboxed frame. The frame has scripts but never the app's origin (sandbox="allow-scripts", no allow-same-origin): a page cannot reach the app, the account or the workspace; its relative images are embedded as data, so no address with a session token reaches it. Everything about it lives in this folder; the core only offers extension points. Both ends read 'fileTypes' (the server through File types, the browser through the copy tools/protocol-sync.mjs writes); 'browser' is the module the page starts.
name: html-page
